identity: ONE original short stocky bearded adult hauler, the Scrip Hauler veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the brass miner helmet with goggles pushed up, the dark beard, the polished brass shoulder and arm plates, the long brown leather work apron with rivets and buckles, the dark undercoat and the brass armoured boots. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The screen-LEFT hand holds ONE short pick-hammer with a curved steel head; the screen-RIGHT arm carries ONE tall dark iron board shield with a brass frame and a row of brass pegs along its top edge. Preserve the pick-hammer, the board shield and the stocky proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full helmet, pick-hammer, shield, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the shield stays rigid and never morphs.

idle_h3_v1.action: A sturdy, alert idle that loops. The hauler breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, the pick-hammer turns a little in the hand, the shield settles on the arm and the helmet turns slightly to scan, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

move_h3_v1.action: March in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with short sturdy steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The shield stays upright on the arm and the pick-hammer swings a little at the side; the apron swings with the legs. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE overhead pick strike toward screen right. The hauler raises the pick-hammer high above the helmet as the knees bend, then steps into a deep lunge and swings it down and forward to full reach at screen right, the shield held close, pulls back and settles into the original stance. One strike only; no sparks or effect at contact.

hit_h3_v1.action: The hauler starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. The helmet and shoulders hunch behind the shield and the knees flex deep while both hands keep hold of the pick-hammer and the shield, then the hauler straightens, rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Crouch low behind the board shield, setting it forward in front of the body with the shoulder braced against it and the pick-hammer drawn in, then hold the braced guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A rallying signal. The hauler raises the pick-hammer high overhead and holds it up as a signal to the crew, then lowers it back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly and heavily from standing. The hauler doubles over and sinks onto both knees, leaning on the shield, stays kneeling a moment, then topples forward and lies flat on the ground, finishing motionless with the helmet at screen right, the shield lying flat beside the head and the pick-hammer on the ground. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
